D5/S3/Quantum/FourierCircuit/Primitives/.name: QuantumAlg.QuantumFourierTransform.Source.qftSource_circuit_event_count
D5/S3/Quantum/FourierCircuit/Primitives/.signature: public lemma qftSource_circuit_event_count (n : Nat) : ResourcePool.count event (circuit oracles n).eventCost = n * (if .gate .hadamard = event then 1 else 0) + n.choose 2 * (if .gate .controlledPhase = event then 1 else 0) + (n / 2) * (if .gate .swap = event then 1 else 0)
